title: Returns & Exchanges
body:
We want you to be satisfied with your purchase. If you need to exchange an item, you have 14 days from the delivery date to request an exchange for a different size. We do not offer refunds; store credit or exchanges only.

To initiate an exchange or report a damaged item, contact us at support@gmfproductions904.com with your order number and photos of the issue. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in their original condition.
